*   GANs consist of two neural networks that compete against each other in a zero-sum game
*   The generator creates fake data while the discriminator tries to distinguish real samples from fakes
*   Early models were often lacking in stability during the training process
*   Researchers improved the architecture to achieve better convergence and higher performance
*   The final output demonstrates high quality images that are nearly indistinguishable from real photos
*   This framework revolutionized fields like art generation and data augmentation

P.P.S The competition drives both networks to become stronger over time.
